faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist-I posts is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-I position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Research Scientist-I position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Project Research Scientist-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Nanomedicine, Nanobiotechnology, Molecular Medicine, or other equivalent streams to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 72,800/- (inclusive of HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist-I posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves merit-based shortlisting followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist-I jobs?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Hyderabad website on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for contractual positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.

faq.question: Q10. Will there be any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such information.
